fact_text: Urea makers that buy gas at a government-set price earn a set margin on each tonne sold, so their returns depend mainly on the terms of their gas supply.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local urea output that roughly matches domestic demand gives producers some pricing power, though all of them sell at the same regulated level.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A fertilizer maker with cheap gas contracts earns more than peers selling the same urea at the same regulated price, and that is the main source of outperformance in the sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After the 2024 IMF programme, gas prices rose for plants on the Sui network but not for those on the Mari network, which the analyst cited as making FFC a stronger multibagger case.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The same 2024 gas-price split between Sui and Mari network plants was cited alongside FFC as making Fatima Fertilizer a better multibagger in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A higher share of current-account deposits lowers a bank's funding cost, which the analyst treats as a key lever for earning more than other banks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A bank stands out from its peers when it combines a strong current-account share, tight operating expenses and low bad loans, since these three effects reinforce each other.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Assembler customers pay booking amounts that help the assembler open letters of credit for parts, and the balance is collected on delivery, so the assembler needs little working capital of its own.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An auto assembler's profits depend heavily on the strength of its international partner's model range and pricing, and a model that wins on features, price and reliability drives sales.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement profits improve with access to cheap electricity, whether from a captive coal plant or from renewables, and coal cost and plant location are the other two factors the analyst weighs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Limestone royalty rates differ by province, so the location of a cement maker's quarry changes its cost base, and a change in royalty rates can reshape profits across the sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Over the next one to two years, cement profit direction depends on whether bag prices rise faster than coal prices, and the analyst checks these two prices together when judging a company.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steelmaking is electricity-intensive, so access to cheap power is a major driver of steel makers' profitability.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Import duties that protect local steel against cheap imports from China and other producers are critical to steel margins, and the analyst pairs them with cheap power as the two main supports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Multinational drugmakers with a broad international portfolio have pricing power, because their branded medicines face few substitutes and patients keep buying even after a price rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local drugmakers grow by launching generics after international patents expire, at low cost, and converting them into large brands; a firm with a strong record of this is likely to keep the same approach.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: New biotech plants being built in Pakistan give local drugmakers another route to launch new products, which the analyst sees as an added benefit for companies that bring them in.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A true multibagger has to grow its own earnings by roughly 25-30% a year; otherwise returns come from rising valuation multiples, which the analyst considers unsustainable over long periods.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Over very long horizons the entry P/E matters less than the business's real profit growth, because profit growth is what creates the value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst compares a stock's P/E with its sector's long-term P/E range and prefers entries at or below that range, not at the top of it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A quality stock bought at a premium of 30-40% to its fair value can trade sideways for about two years while earnings catch up, which frustrates holders who bought near the peak.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Entry timing combines three checks: the P/E against the sector range, the earnings drivers expected over the next one to two years, and any policy change that could shift them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Deeply undervalued stocks often find no buyers during a crisis, so the analyst argues investors should rely on valuation rather than wait for the market to confirm a recovery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At each quarterly result, check that the original reasons for owning a multibagger still hold, such as cheap gas, a strong current-account share or a favourable duty structure, since a policy change can break the thesis.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's reasoning for weights inside a pool of about 30-35 quality multibaggers: a holding trading about 50% above fair value is reduced, and a comparable holding trading 30-35% below fair value gets more weight.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Multibagger Stocks Checklist: What to Look For Right Now' (YouTube transcript, undated)
